home.description: We solve so many problems, challenges and decision making needs every day. But sometimes we encounter situations that require a closer look - and maybe a fresh perspective. Let's discover it together!

coaching.title: Systemic Coaching
coaching.description: In my coaching sessions I support you in finding clarity and structure in your toughts and to grow in phases of development - whether professional, private or in between. You don't need to have a clear goal, it's enough if you notice: I want something to change.
coaching.topic2: conflicts in private or work life
coaching.feature1_description: Whether we are satisfied with our work life or not, it quickly affects all other areas of life. All the more reason it can be worthwhile to consciously engage with it
coaching.feature1_item1: Where do I want to start my professional career?
coaching.feature1_item2: How can I deal more calmly with professional conflicts?
coaching.feature1_item3: Is now the right time for a job change?
coaching.feature1_item4: How do I make the transition to a new industry?
coaching.approach_description: My approach to coaching is based on systemic and person-centered components, as well as my personal experience. The most important thing is that you have a safe and motivating space to explore your concerns and face challenges, free from judgments and advice. Even though I find it exciting to constantly educate myself and am happy to offer you various tools, in the end the focus is on you deciding for yourself how you achieve your goals.

about.description: I am a certified coach and with a professional background in business and data anyltics. But my passion - next to learning new languages, (Italian) Food, good books and the outdoors - is in accompanying people on their way to solve their own thought puzzles. As I am relatively new on this journey I am always looking for new inspirations to incorporate in my sessions and happy to gather more feedback. My approach combines proven techniques with personalized strategies tailored to your unique situation.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.answer1: Coaching is a collaborative process that helps individuals identify and achieve their personal and professional goals through guided self-discovery and actionable strategies.
faq.answer2: Typical coaching sessions last 60 minutes, but can be adjusted based on your needs and preferences.
faq.question3: How many sessions will I need?
faq.answer3: The number of sessions varies depending on your goals and progress. We'll discuss this during our initial consultation.
faq.answer4: My coaching methodology combines evidence-based techniques from positive psychology, cognitive-behavioral approaches, and solution-focused strategies.
